competitorWins: Google Earth is the gold standard for exploring a static world: the most detailed 3D cities anywhere, Street View, the deepest historical imagery archive (decades back), powerful measurement and drawing tools, GIS data import, KMZ/KML sharing and Earth Studio for cinematic animations — all permanently free. Nobody matches its imagery depth, 3D building coverage and the familiarity billions of users already have. For deep place exploration, its scale is untouchable.
description: Google Earth (by Google) is the world's most detailed free virtual globe: satellite and aerial imagery, 3D cities, Street View, historical imagery going back decades, and mapping tools — with Google Earth Pro (once $399/year) free since 2015. But its imagery is archival, not live: no live flights, ships, cameras or real-time events. WorldEye is complementary for the live planet: a free 3D globe of what's happening NOW — live flights, ships, cameras, weather, quakes and wildfires.
